system.prerequisites: Spellcaster, Meditation 3 ranks, Religion or Occultism 3 ranks
system.description:
ADEPT

You have stopped dismissing dreams, coincidences and impossible intuitions as chance. Something occasionally shows you what has not yet happened.
You gain Prophecy Lore as a specialist skill.
You also gain Read Omen as a Specialist Spell. The spell uses your normal magical tradition.
Once per day, whenever you achieve at least a Success when casting Read Omen, you may retain one fragment of the revelation as a Portent which has the following effect:
Before your next daily preparations, when you or an ally within 30 feet attempts a saving throw or skill check, you may use a Reaction to grant that check a +1-status bonus.
You must declare the Portent before the result is determined.

Prerequisites Spellcaster, Meditation 3 ranks, Religion or Occultism 3 ranks

Progression Requirements Religion +10 ranks

Works automatically: Prophecy Lore is added to your specialist skills and Read Omen is granted as a specialist spell (it arrives with the Grimoire block); Use once per day after a Success or better on Read Omen to hold a Portent, and Use again as the Reaction to spend it — +1 status queued on the target's check.
